criteria.justification: The proposal details a composable CDP architecture on Google Cloud with BigQuery storage, streaming and micro‑batch ingestion, deterministic and fuzzy identity resolution, and listed integrations for Salesforce and SAP, plus a scalability claim to 25 million profiles, meeting most technical capability aspects but lacking deeper performance metrics.
criteria.evidence: We propose a composable CDP on Google Cloud (EU region) with a BigQuery-based unified profile store, near-real-time streaming ingestion for web and app events, and 15‑minute micro‑batch ingestion for POS and loyalty. ... Integrations: standard connectors for Salesforce Service Cloud and an SAP integration built on SAP Integration Suite. The platform supports 25 million profiles on the proposed tier and scales by upgrading the tier.

criteria.justification: Provides a clear 22‑week timeline with phased milestones, detailed staffing list (11 FTE at peak) and a risk register with specific mitigations, demonstrating a robust implementation plan; minor gaps in contingency depth keep it just short of full marks.
criteria.evidence: Delivery runs for 22 weeks in five stage‑gated phases... Team (named in Appendix A): engagement director, delivery manager, solution architect, 4 data engineers, 2 marketing‑automation specialists, QA lead, change and training lead - 11 FTE at peak, 70%... Risk plan: a live risk register with owners and mitigations. Top risks: (1) SAP data quality - mitigated by a data‑profiling sprint in weeks 3‑4; (2) identity match rate below target - mitigated by tuning cycles with a 95% acceptance gate; (3) peak‑season freeze - go‑live scheduled before the November change freeze with a rollback plan rehearsed in UAT; (4) key‑person dependency - named deputies for every lead role.

criteria.justification: Pricing is presented as a fixed‑price implementation with a detailed cost breakdown and clear assumptions, offering good commercial transparency; however, limited detail on post‑implementation cost variations beyond CPI‑linked caps reduces the score slightly.
criteria.evidence: Fixed‑price implementation with milestone‑based payments (20/30/30/20). Prices exclude VAT. Item Price (EUR) Implementation (fixed price, 22 weeks) 520,000 ... Platform licence & Google Cloud hosting, per year 118,000 ... Managed support (24x7), per year 36,000 ... Total cost of ownership, 3 years 982,000 ... Assumptions: pricing covers up to 25 million profiles and 20 journeys; Northwind provides a product owner at 50% allocation; travel is included; change requests at EUR 950 per day; year‑2 and year‑3 prices are capped at CPI + 2%.

criteria.justification: The supplier lists ISO 27001 certification, SOC 2 Type I completed, upcoming Type II, and multiple security controls (encryption, MFA, least‑privilege, GDPR workflows, audit logging), satisfying most security and compliance requirements; pending SOC 2 Type II audit prevents a perfect score.
criteria.evidence: NexaWorks is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and has completed a SOC 2 Type I assessment; the SOC 2 Type II audit is scheduled for Q1 2027. Data is hosted in Google Cloud europe‑west3 (Frankfurt). Controls: encryption at rest and in transit, SSO with MFA, least‑privilege roles, consent and preference centre with per‑channel opt‑in, automated GDPR access/erasure workflows, and audit logging of all profile access. We will sign Northwind's DPA and support a DPIA.

criteria.justification: Describes a 24x7 follow‑the‑sun support model with SLAs, a Technical Account Manager, and a hypercare period, plus experience of 14 similar programmes and references; however, references are fictional and no quantitative support metrics are provided, limiting the score.
criteria.evidence: Support: 24x7 follow‑the‑sun service desk (Pune, Lisbon, Toronto) with a dedicated Technical Account Manager. SLAs: P1 response 15 minutes and restore target 4 hours; P2 response 1 hour; P3 response 8 hours. Service credits apply when SLAs are missed. Monthly service reviews and quarterly roadmap sessions are included, together with a 90‑day hypercare period after go‑live. Experience: 14 CDP or marketing‑automation programmes since 2019, including six for multi‑country retailers. References (fictional): Director of CRM, Harbor & Pine Outfitters; VP Digital, Kestrel Supermarkets; Head of Loyalty, Solstice Beauty.

risks: Key‑person dependency risk is noted with named deputies but lacks a detailed succession or knowledge‑transfer plan.
Scalability is capped at 25 million profiles; the proposal does not address growth beyond this limit.
leaderboard.overall_summary: NexaWorks presents a well‑structured technical solution, clear implementation timeline, transparent pricing, and solid security certifications.
